proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E ι _ _ b x
  have h := RCLike.hasSum_re 𝕜 (b.hasSum_inner_mul_inner x x)
  have h1 : (fun i => RCLike.re (inner 𝕜 x (b i) * inner 𝕜 (b i) x)) =
      fun i => ‖inner 𝕜 (b i) x‖ ^ 2 := by
    funext i
    rw [← inner_conj_symm x (b i), RCLike.conj_mul, ← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.ofReal_re]
  rw [h1, inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h
  exact h
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E ι : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (b : HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E), HasSum (fun i => ‖inner 𝕜 (b i) x‖ ^ 2) (‖x‖ ^ 2)
